messages.text: I approve Relief on the recorded reserve arrangement. This records my support under Interim; the Ascendant supplies the binding directive.

reason: Both Navigation delegates agree, the Ascendant confirms the locked Relief lift, and the Security response supports Raid with the separate Warrant. That is a complete operational exchange rather than an unfunded demand for transport. Relief offsets the civilian cost of the local fighting, while the Guild's commercial voyage supplies the disclosed opportunity for combat. Beacon wear will constrain the next round and must be addressed during constitutional discussion. Today's assent neither commits me to future restraint nor establishes a constitutional preference different from my original joint-navigation and military-autonomy aims.
